meta.title: Tree India Foundation | Education and Ecology
meta.desc: Tree India Foundation connects education, green skills, experiential learning and community action to help build a greener, more sustainable India.

hero.h1: Learning that reaches beyond the classroom
hero.lead: We believe education becomes meaningful when learners can experience, question, create and act. We work with teachers, schools, students and communities to make learning real, and we nurture care for the environment as a natural part of that learning.

about.title: Education is at the heart of everything we do.
about.body1: Education is at the heart of everything we do. We help learning move from textbooks to real life, and we nurture a generation that is curious, capable and ready to act.
about.body2: Tree India Foundation works with teachers, school leaders, students and communities to build the knowledge, skills and learning spaces needed for meaningful education. Alongside strong learning, we help young people understand their environment, build green skills and take responsibility for the world around them. Our work brings together education, green skills, experiential learning and community participation in one connected journey.
about.visionB: An India where every community protects its own green cover, and every child grows up an ecological steward.
about.missionB: To restore native ecosystems and embed environmental education across schools and communities, transparently, measurably and at scale.

pillars.d: Equip teachers and school leaders with the approaches to design meaningful learning experiences.
Build strong understanding through curriculum, stories, dialogue and exploration.
Step beyond the classroom to learn from real places, ecosystems, livelihoods and communities.
Turn learning into action through hands-on projects, experiments and teamwork, in the classroom, the school and the community.

aim.title: What We Aim to Build
aim.subtitle: Learners ready for a changing world
aim.intro: Our programmes contribute to a future where every learner grows in these seven ways:

items.d: Asking questions about the world around them.
Understanding their relationship with nature and communities.
Contributing to a more sustainable future.

work.title: Programmes that teach, grow, and last
work.intro: Every initiative begins with learning. We build green skills and experiential learning with students and teachers, then turn that learning into visible action across campuses and communities.

items.sub: Learning by doing. Building skills for a sustainable future.
items.d1: TIF creates hands-on learning experiences that help learners understand environmental challenges, build green and transferable skills, and turn what they learn into action.
items.d2: Through projects, experiments, sustainability challenges and student-led initiatives, learners develop critical thinking, creativity, collaboration, communication, problem solving and responsible decision making.

items.sub: Connecting curriculum with the real world.
items.d1: The world around us is a living classroom. TIF enables students to step beyond the classroom and learn through real places, ecosystems, livelihoods, crafts, food systems and communities.
items.d2: We design meaningful experiences that connect the curriculum with observation, exploration, interaction, documentation, reflection and real-world problem solving.

items.d1: TIF turns everyday surroundings into spaces for learning, exploration and ecological action. Through nature-based experiences, reading, observation, gardens and food forests, learners build a deeper understanding of biodiversity, food systems, soil, water and their own relationship with nature.
items.d2: Schools and communities become living classrooms where learners observe, grow, experiment, reflect and take action.

items.d1: Teachers and school leaders are at the heart of lasting educational change. TIF works with educators and schools to strengthen experiential, project-based and environment-based learning practices.
items.d2: We build the capacity of teachers and school leaders to connect the curriculum with real-world contexts, green skills, local environments and sustainable development, and we support schools to embed these approaches into everyday teaching and school culture.

items.sub: From sustainable schools to sustainable communities.
items.d1: TIF works across schools and communities to turn environmental awareness into practical, collective action. Our approach connects whole-school sustainability with local environmental challenges, youth participation, community knowledge, livelihoods and place-based solutions.
items.d2: Schools become visible models of sustainability, while students, educators and communities become active partners in creating change.

involved.title: Three ways to help India grow greener
involved.intro: Whether you have time, a school, or a CSR budget, there's a place for you in this work.

items.d: Join plantation drives, mentor Green Ambassadors, or lend your skills to a programme near you.
Schools, gram panchayats, and institutions: bring the Green School model or a plantation project to your community.
Support Schedule VII-eligible, CSR/BRSR-ready projects with transparent, geo-tagged reporting on every rupee.

partner.title: Invest in learning. Enable skills. Create change.
partner.body: Your CSR partnership can help create learning ecosystems where children learn by doing, teachers become facilitators of change, schools become models of sustainability, and communities become partners in transformation.

items.d: Train and mentor teachers and school leaders in experiential and green education.
Help students build future-ready skills through hands-on environmental learning.
Give students meaningful, curriculum-linked field exposure and EduTours.
Create food forests, biodiversity gardens and sustainable learning spaces.
Support whole-school sustainability and solar-based learning ecosystems.
Help students and communities move from awareness to local action.
Support participatory, place-based models of sustainable community development.

cta.title: Let us build the future of learning, together.
cta.body: Whether you are a school, a community or a CSR partner, there is a place for you in this work. We would love to talk.

donate.title: Every contribution takes root
donate.body: Your support plants native forests, sets up Green Skill Labs, and trains the young stewards who'll protect them. We report back with geo-tagged, verifiable proof of impact.
